WITH order_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT
    op.order_id AS order_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_installments,
    ABS(SUM(COALESCE(op.payment_value, 0))) AS order_total_amount
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN opt.has_installments = 1 THEN 'installments'
    ELSE 'no_installments'
  END AS payment_installments_indicator,
  AVG(opt.order_total_amount) AS average_order_value
FROM order_payment_totals opt
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN opt.has_installments = 1 THEN 'installments'
    ELSE 'no_installments'
  END;
